title: Speakeasy Utilities
description: A shared library providing common systems, utilities, and APIs for the Speakeasy mod collection.
body:
Speakeasy Utilities is the shared library and foundation for the Speakeasy collection of Minecraft mods.

It contains common systems, APIs, helper classes, utilities, and other shared functionality used across the Speakeasy ecosystem. By centralizing these features into a single dependency, other Speakeasy mods remain smaller, easier to maintain, and receive improvements as the library evolves.

Features  
- Shared APIs for Speakeasy mods  
- Common utility classes and helper methods  
- Shared attribute and gameplay systems   
- Reusable sound and animation helpers  
- Cross-mod compatibility support   
- Foundation for future Speakeasy projects   

Speakeasy Utilities is required for:   
- Speakeasy Enchantments  
- Speakeasy Animated Dyes  
- Speakeasy Equipment (coming soon)  

Additional Speakeasy mods will depend on this library in future updates.

Note: This is a library/dependency mod and does not add significant standalone gameplay content. It is intended to be installed alongside one or more Speakeasy mods that require it.
